messages:
Maria: Quick sync on mitigation action items from the incident this morning. I sketched concrete owners/timelines and which evals/tests we need added.
Tom: Thanks. which ones should be top of the stack?
Maria: Top priorities: 1) small regression prompt set for the chat fallback path, 2) a short burst load test (replay the spike pattern we saw), 3) KV-cache eviction chaos drill in staging, 4) gate in CI with a light eval pass pre-deploy.
Linda: Paste the failing prompts? I can start the regression harness.
Maria: Repro prompts we captured (scrubbed):
```
1) "Summarize this long support ticket and extract action items: <redacted>"
2) "From thread history, generate a concise follow-up with bullets."
3) "Re-rank these results for intent X and state the single best reason."
```
Tom: I'll add a k6/locust scenario: 180-220 concurrent users for 60s with staggered sequences; include mid-sequence long generations to stress KV.
Kevin: For KV eviction: plan a chaos job that forces aggressive TTL/eviction and measures error/tail-latency. Add alert when p99 gen time climbs >30% vs baseline.
Maria: Proposed owners/timelines:
- Linda -> regression prompt suite + CI job (non-blocking) due in 5 business days.
- Tom -> load test scenario + replay runbook due in 7 days.
- Kevin -> KV eviction chaos drill + dashboard panel due in 14 days.
- Maria -> add eval thresholds & gating notes to release checklist due in 3 business days.
Linda: I'll land a minimal PR under eng-ml/evals/regressions/incident-1768004321 and tag it evals:nonblocking.
Tom: I'll create replay/ with k6 config and a tiny dockerized invoker that uses the same model variants as prod. Will add exact command to run in runbook.
Kevin: I'll export a scrubbed long-history trace to include in the regression set so it hits KV behavior.
Maria: Decision on CI gating: start non-blocking (warn only). After 2 clean runs within a week, flip to blocking. Agree?
Tom: Agree. Avoid false positives initially.
Linda: Agreed. I'll wire the job to post results to the evals dashboard and the triage thread.
Ops Bot: Reminder: create tracking tickets and add label incident-1768004321.
Maria: I've created JIRA tickets: INC-3247 (tracking) and EVAL-889 (regression). PRs: https://git.redwood.co/r/1345 (regression), https://git.redwood.co/r/1346 (k6). I'll link CI shards when they finish.
Kevin: Adding a dashboard panel for p99 during eviction now, will post link.
Tom: If anyone is blocked on infra toggles, ping @ops.
Linda: PR open; CI runs are minimal tests for now.
Maria: I'll add a recurring weekly check on the regression results to the triage agenda and mark the action items in the postmortem.
Kevin: Scheduling chaos drill in staging next Thursday; will loop @ops for infra toggles.
Cara: Quick UX check: prompt #2 is a bit open-ended, suggest tightening expectations to reduce flakiness. I'll comment on the PR.
Maria: Thanks all. Expect initial PRs and JIRA links by EOD. We'll reconvene in #eng-ml on Friday with results.
Tom: \ud83d\udc4d
Linda: On it :rocket:
